module: Flowgraph node "Add Or Remove Player Attribute" (category once_instant, career color/icon). Adds or removes an amount of a player attribute (default "money") in the current career save slot, via career_modules_playerAttributes.addAttributes. Inputs: add (bool, true = add, default true), amount (number, default 0), playerAttribute (string, default 'money'), reason (string, log text; otherwise key "ui.career.attributeLog.unknownFlowgraphReason"). Acts only in career and only once until reset.
notes: The internal flag prevents a second application until the node is reset (reset pin or onNodeReset).
The pin descriptions talk about money ("money") even though the attribute is configurable.

onNodeReset.desc: Sets the applied flag back to false.

_executionStarted.desc: Calls onNodeReset when the graph starts.

work.desc: If career is active and not yet applied, adds amount (signed according to add) to the attribute and marks it applied; resets if the reset pin is active.
